title: U.S.O. Performance
text: At ease, boys. Well, I hope to see those feet move that fast on the battlefield. Thank you, sir! Hard to believe there's this much talent in our very own 171st Division, eh? And here to lift your spirits on Christmas Eve, you may recognize her from the medic tent by its nurse, Aubra July. Well, I may be a lousy medic, but let's see if I can be a half-decent singer. All right, simmer down now, fellows. Just sit on your helmets and enjoy. Now, I know you boys miss home this Christmas Eve. Maybe you're missing someone special. Well, I've got a song just for you. But first, I need a volunteer. Oh, me, me, me, me, me, me! How about you, handsome? Ooh! Why, Private Garrett's the toughest guy in our unit. Yeah, this should be a guess. Do you have another song, Love Fight? Well, maybe I heard it when I was a boy. I'll follow your lead. It's a shuffle and see, four on the floor. Just stay on the rhythm and you can't go wrong. Hit it. Hello? Baby, listen, I ain't coming home tonight. Boy, stop. Here we go with this mess. Again. I mean it. I got work. Don't wait up. Is that right? Because I know that you've been hanging out all night. Girl, you know I cannot help that I'm a man. You can help the way you treat me. Woman, don't please me. I swear to you, I'll walk away. Shut your mouth. You're pissing me off. Whoa, whoa, yeah, yeah. Doing me wrong and doing you right. Where do you go in the middle of the night? Doing me wrong. Doing you wrong ain't doing me right. You're pissing me off. Baby, it's a... Hey, is this a play? I don't know, but it sure is noisy. Well, whatever it is, seems like Private Garrett is off book. Wait, so the girl is playing the boy and the boy is playing the girl? Yeah, there's a lot going on. Quit your lying. My girlfriend, Shanice, saw you at the club. She needs to get her eyes checked. She did yesterday. I've given you all of me, my mind, my body. Can't you see? Then why's the car smell like sex with a girl that isn't me? Whoa, whoa, yeah, yeah. Break it down now, y'all. Really nailing the choreo. But he got caught. Now he's being mouthy. He's not going to change. Once a cheater, always a cheater. Shh. She's confronting him. Remind me, do you wear red satin panties? Girl, you know I don't. Then why did I find these in your briefcase? I've been looking for those. Mom, that must be the other woman. The one who stunk the car up? This is the moment of truth. Baby, it ain't what it looks like. Oh, yeah, because it looks bad. Consider this a warning. You're on notice. How can I make it up to you both? Why? It's simple. Defeat the Nazis. Mama, you ain't saying nothing but a word. Whoa, whoa, yeah, yeah, doing me wrong. Hey.
